research_routes.authority_scope: USTRANSCOM DP3 public library and 2021-2026 business-rule folders
research_routes.result: The official public library still exposed the archived 12 August 2022 listing. Exact-phrase searches located tariff copies and historical tariffs but no superseding listing, advisory, worked example, or accessible TSP OTO User Guide that reconciled the four gaps.
research_routes.artifact_handling: Search extracts and unarchived online copies were locator aids only and were not promoted into source claims.

research_routes.authority_scope: Current DTR Part IV Chapter A-402
research_routes.result: The DTR treats BOTO as a distinct shipment/program context and supplies bill-of-lading handling, but it does not reconcile Item 130F with the domestic item-code rows or define Item 130 billable quantity.
research_routes.artifact_handling: The already archived DTR was inspected; no new claim was necessary for the four gap determinations.

findings.finding: The governing tariff expressly includes riding lawnmowers, including stand-on models, under 130B. Complete inspection of candidate rows 53-70 finds no lawnmower description, and no authoritative superseding row or crosswalk was located.
findings.prohibited_inference: Do not map a lawnmower to another 130B row by similarity or emit a billing code.

findings.finding: The tariff expressly names boats, dinghies, sculls, skiffs, and row boats over 14 feet when shipped with household goods. Candidate rows 89-90 describe only boats over 14 feet. No authority states that the row description is an umbrella for the other named subtypes.
findings.prohibited_inference: Do not collapse all named 130E watercraft into the generic boat row without approval.

findings.finding: Item 130F labels boat trailers at most 16 feet and says boat trailers are handled under BOTO, while the tariff definitions and Item 301 select BOTO for over-14-foot or over-dimension boat units when the HHG TSP does not agree to move them with household goods. Candidate rows 91-92 simultaneously present 130F as domestic 400NG origin and destination representations. Public authority did not reconcile these statements.
findings.prohibited_inference: Do not select BOTO, dHHG Item 130F, or a financial treatment from trailer length alone.

findings.finding: The tariff states one charge for each required combined loading-and-unloading service. The candidate listing supplies separate origin and destination representations for every Item 130 description. No authority explains whether those rows are approval-routing representations, alternative entry points, or independently billable occurrences.
findings.prohibited_inference: Do not derive billable quantity, pair selection, or two charges from the row structure.

required_clarification: Current authoritative Item 130 item-code listing or explicit continuation statement
130B row for riding lawnmowers including stand-on models
130E mapping for dinghies, sculls, skiffs, and row boats over 14 feet moved with HHG
130F relationship between dHHG rows and BOTO selection criteria
Meaning of origin/destination rows relative to one combined loading-and-unloading charge

next_safe_action: Keep all four gaps open and non-monetary. Seek publisher clarification only with owner approval; otherwise preserve candidate facts and human review without mapping or quantity output.
